definition: Debits and credits are the left- and right-side entries of double-entry accounting, and their effects on balances depend on the account type.
entry_text: Debits and credits are the left- and right-side entries of double-entry accounting, and their effects on balances depend on the account type.
example: A cash purchase of supplies debits the supplies asset account and credits the cash asset account.
label: Debits and credits
